title: Accepted Teardown Labor Rates by Prior Repair Class (Repair Estimates & Appointments Insurer Schedule)
content:
**Rate schedule.** For the insurer's direct payment toward a Repair Estimates & Appointments teardown charge, the accepted teardown rate follows the structure the network last repaired on the vehicle, read from the vehicle's closed network repair order under Insurance Claim Repairs and its repair class:

| Vehicle's closed network insurance claim repair order | Accepted teardown rate |
|---|---|
| Aluminum Certified Structural Claim Repair | 105.00 USD an hour |
| Structural Claim Repair or Certified Structural Claim Repair | 80.00 USD an hour |
| No closed repair order of these classes | not set by this schedule |

For a vehicle whose closed network insurance claim repair order was an Aluminum Certified Structural Claim Repair the insurer accepts 105.00 USD; for one whose closed repair order was a Structural Claim Repair or a Certified Structural Claim Repair it accepts 80.00 USD.

Points of judgement (hypothetical vehicles): a closed Express Claim Repair is not one of the listed classes — not set by this schedule; a closed Certified Structural Claim Repair — 80.00 USD an hour; a structural-class repair order that is still in repair is not closed — not set by this schedule.
